question_for_user: The card's arm-B schedule rules conflict with the admitted data. Schedule v2 rules are 13 edit + 3 no-op per update (18.75% no-ops), every edit once, and each no-op row seen at most 3 times. With only 1,094 no-op rows, a cap of 3 allows 3,282 no-op draws, enough for at most 14,222 edits at 13:3. Arm B has 17,773 edits (13,912 TRAIN + 3,861 roxygen). Option (a): keep 13:3 and 18.75%. That gives 1,368 updates with gates at 342/684/1,026/1,368, and 822 no-op rows are seen 4 times (272 seen 3 times). It is already built with the unchanged C04 code. Option (b): keep the cap at 3. The no-op share then falls to 15.6% and needs mixed 13:3/14:2 updates, a schedule_v2 code change. Which do you want? Recommended: (a). With the same no-op share as arm A, R3's nofp comparison measures the roxygen rows rather than a composition change, and 4 exposures stays below the 4-5 the audit flagged.
